categoryName: Frozen & chilled — peas, parathas, nuggets, momos, fries, ice cream tubs

skuLines.examples: Safal 500g, Sumeru Green Peas 500g, HyFun Green Peas, Godrej Yummiez Peas
skuLines.seasonality: Peaks Nov–Feb (hill winter, fresh veg scarce) and Jul–Sep (monsoon road closures rot fresh produce); local Sirmaur/Solan fresh pea season competes Feb–Apr
skuLines.notes: The single anchor SKU of this lane. Needs unbroken -18°C; a soft/clumped brick is instantly visible to the buyer and kills repeat purchase. 12–18 month shelf life if the chain holds.

skuLines.line: Frozen green peas — canteen / bulk pack
skuLines.examples: Safal 1kg institutional, Sumeru 1kg, HyFun catering pack
skuLines.notes: ARY's two canteens + messes are the volume buyer, not households. Buy on a weekly indent so freezer space is not tied up; bulk packs are the first thing to suffer if the deep freezer loses power.

skuLines.examples: Safal Sweet Corn 500g, Sumeru American Sweet Corn, Green Farm
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; corn-chaat and soup demand spikes in cold months
skuLines.notes: Second-highest-rotation frozen veg after peas. Also feeds the canteen's corn chaat / soup counter.

skuLines.examples: Safal Mixed Vegetables 500g, Sumeru Mix Veg, HyFun Mixed Veg
skuLines.notes: Sells to staff-quarter kitchens as a one-pack answer to pulao/mix-veg when the F&V counter is thin.

skuLines.examples: HyFun Frozen Okra, Safal Bhindi, Sumeru Cut Okra
skuLines.seasonality: Strong Jul–Sep — fresh bhindi is the first vegetable to rot on a wet hill road
skuLines.notes: High-value monsoon line precisely because the fresh alternative fails. Do not overstock in local fresh-bhindi season.

skuLines.examples: Safal Palak, Sumeru Chopped Spinach, HyFun Spinach
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; peaks in monsoon when leafy greens spoil in transit
skuLines.notes: Cheap, high-turn, and the palak-paneer combination sells frozen paneer alongside it. Blanched-and-frozen holds colour better than 3-day-old fresh.

skuLines.examples: Sumeru Broccoli, HyFun Cauliflower Florets, Safal
skuLines.seasonality: Broccoli year-round; cauliflower only off-season (local fresh gobhi is abundant and cheap in HP winter)
skuLines.notes: Broccoli is the real line here — rarely available fresh on campus. Frozen cauliflower loses to local fresh most of the year; keep depth low.

skuLines.line: Frozen French beans / carrot / diced cut vegetables
skuLines.examples: Safal French Beans, Sumeru Cut Carrot, HyFun Diced Veg
skuLines.notes: Single-vegetable packs are slow movers next to peas/corn/mix; carry one or two facings, not the full range.

skuLines.examples: Sumeru Button Mushroom, HyFun Sliced Mushroom
skuLines.notes: Solan is India's fresh-mushroom hub ~50km away, so fresh usually wins on price and quality. Stock thin; frozen matters only when the road is shut.

skuLines.line: Frozen fruit — mango chunks / pulp, mixed berries
skuLines.examples: Safal Mango Pulp, Sumeru Mango Cubes, iD/Urban Platter Frozen Berries
skuLines.seasonality: Mango pulp Sept–Apr (off-season shakes/lassi); berries year-round premium
skuLines.notes: Berries are a genuine premium line for university-staff households and the bakery. Mango pulp is a cheap high-turn shake input for the canteen.

skuLines.examples: McCain French Fries 420g, HyFun Classic Fries 420g, Sumeru Fries
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; dips during residential breaks when the campus empties
skuLines.notes: Highest-velocity frozen snack in Indian modern trade. On-pack air-fryer instructions now drive the purchase — face the pack that carries them.

skuLines.examples: McCain 2.5kg Shoestring/Classic, HyFun 2.5kg, Sumeru bulk
skuLines.notes: The two ARY canteens and any hostel-side counter buy at this pack, not 420g. One 2.5kg bag converts to ~₹1,200–1,800 of counter sales — the highest-leverage frozen line on campus.

skuLines.examples: McCain Smiles 415g, HyFun Smileys, McCain Aloo Shots
skuLines.seasonality: Term-time only — collapses during residential breaks
skuLines.notes: The #1 child-pull SKU in the whole frozen cabinet. With ~2,000+ school children resident and a canteen to fry them, carry both the household and the catering pack.

skuLines.line: Frozen aloo tikki / veg burger patty
skuLines.examples: McCain Aloo Tikki 400g, HyFun Aloo Tikki, Yummiez Veg Burger Patty
skuLines.notes: Feeds the canteen burger/tikki-chaat counter and the family kitchen equally. Long freezer life, forgiving of minor temperature swings compared with ice cream.

skuLines.line: Frozen hash browns / potato wedges / potato bites
skuLines.examples: McCain Hash Browns, HyFun Potato Wedges, McCain Potato Cheese Shotz
skuLines.notes: Breakfast-side line for staff families; slower than fries and smiles, so one or two facings each.

skuLines.line: Frozen cheese-filled bites — cheese shots, jalapeno poppers, corn-cheese balls
skuLines.examples: McCain Cheese Shots 400g, HyFun Cheesy Corn Nuggets, Yummiez Cheese Corn Balls
skuLines.notes: Premium impulse aimed at Eternal University students and young staff. Cheese fillings are the least tolerant of a freeze-thaw cycle — burst/leaked pieces generate complaints, so first-in-first-out strictly.

skuLines.examples: Godrej Yummiez Veg Nuggets, ITC Master Chef Veg Nuggets, HyFun Veg Nuggets
skuLines.notes: On a vegetarian campus the veg nugget carries all the demand the chicken nugget carries elsewhere — treat it as a must-have, not a substitute.

skuLines.examples: ITC Master Chef Veg Momos, Wow! Momo frozen veg, Godrej Yummiez Momos, Sumeru Momos
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; strongest Oct–Mar (a hot steamed momo in hill cold)
skuLines.notes: Momos are the defining student food of the Himachal belt — steamed, not fried, so a canteen needs only a steamer. Frozen momos moved from metro-only to Tier-2/3 general trade in 2024–26, so supply now exists.

skuLines.examples: Godrej Yummiez Veg Spring Roll, ITC Master Chef Spring Rolls, Sumeru
skuLines.notes: Canteen-friendly; pastry sheets crack if the pack is repeatedly softened, so avoid stocking in the freezer door.

skuLines.examples: Godrej Yummiez Mini Samosa, Sumeru Punjabi Samosa, Bikanervala frozen samosa
skuLines.seasonality: Spikes for functions, Gurpurab, convocation, staff gatherings
skuLines.notes: Function catering is a real revenue event on a campus with no alcohol — samosa + ice cream is the celebration pair. Keep a catering pack for event orders.

skuLines.line: Frozen paneer snacks — paneer tikka, paneer fingers, paneer cutlets
skuLines.examples: ITC Master Chef Paneer Pops, Yummiez Paneer Fingers, HyFun Paneer Tikka
skuLines.notes: Premium veg-protein snack; sits naturally next to frozen paneer blocks in the same cabinet.

skuLines.line: Frozen veg kebabs / cutlets — hara bhara, soya seekh, veg shami
skuLines.examples: ITC Master Chef Hara Bhara Kebab, Yummiez Veg Kebab, Vezlay Soya Seekh
skuLines.notes: Reads as 'proper food' rather than junk to older staff, which widens the buyer base beyond students.

skuLines.line: Frozen onion rings / assorted fried veg starters
skuLines.examples: McCain Onion Rings, HyFun Veg Starter Mix, Sumeru Assorted Starters
skuLines.notes: Filler line — carry only if freezer facings allow after the core snack set is deep enough.

skuLines.examples: iD Fresh Malabar Paratha, Sumeru Laccha Paratha, Yummiez Malabar Paratha, Kawan
skuLines.notes: The largest frozen-bread sub-segment in India. Cooks on a tawa with no oven, which is exactly what a staff-quarter kitchen has.

skuLines.line: Frozen stuffed paratha — aloo, paneer, gobhi, mooli, mix
skuLines.examples: Haldiram's Aloo Paratha, Sumeru Stuffed Paratha, Yummiez Paneer Paratha, Vadilal Quick Treats
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; strongest Nov–Feb (winter breakfast) and exam/term-start weeks
skuLines.notes: Culturally the closest fit of any frozen line to a Punjabi/Sikh household — a hot stuffed paratha with curd is the default breakfast. Highest-conviction non-peas frozen bet.

skuLines.examples: iD Fresh Chapati (chilled), Sumeru Plain Paratha, Kawan Roti
skuLines.notes: iD's chapati/paratha runs CHILLED (4°C, ~5–7 day life), not frozen — a different and much less forgiving logistics problem on a 30–50km hill road. Frozen equivalents are safer for this location.

skuLines.examples: iD Fresh Idli Dosa Batter, Milky Mist Batter, Bake&Cook
skuLines.notes: Serves the South-Indian teaching/non-teaching staff cohort a residential campus always has. CHILLED with a ~5–7 day life and it ferments and bloats if the chain warms — the single riskiest line in this lane for a hill road. Small, frequent indents only.

skuLines.examples: Kawan Naan, Sumeru Butter Naan, Yummiez Kulcha, Vadilal Naan
skuLines.notes: Turns a canteen or a family dinner into a 'restaurant meal' with no tandoor. Pairs with frozen paneer and RTC gravies — merchandise them together.

skuLines.examples: McCain Pizza Pockets, Sumeru Frozen Pizza, Cremica Pizza Base, Kwality Wall's-adjacent private label
skuLines.notes: There is no pizza outlet within 30–50km — this line captures a want that otherwise leaks off-campus entirely. Needs mozzarella stocked in the same chiller to work.

skuLines.line: Frozen puff pastry sheets / patty dough
skuLines.examples: Rich's Puff Pastry, Tropolite Pastry Sheets, Switz
skuLines.notes: Bought by the canteen/bakery side rather than households. Sheets fuse together permanently after a thaw-refreeze, so buy small and turn fast.

skuLines.examples: Amul Malai Paneer 200g, Mother Dairy Paneer, Milky Mist Paneer, Verka Paneer
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spikes for functions and langar-adjacent cooking
skuLines.notes: On a vegetarian campus paneer IS the protein. Frozen paneer specifically solves this location's problem — fresh paneer has a 3–5 day chilled life that a 30–50km hill road plus monsoon closures repeatedly breaks. Boundary line with the dairy lane; stock it in this cabinet regardless of who buys it.

skuLines.line: Frozen soya chaap / soya chunks / mock-meat veg
skuLines.examples: Vezlay Soya Chaap, Vezlay Veg Chicken, Blue Tribe plant-based, GoodDot, Hello Tempayy
skuLines.notes: Soya chaap is a North-Indian mainstream item, not a niche — and on a strictly vegetarian campus the 'veg chicken / veg kebab' format has unusual headroom. Category repositioned in 2025–26 around high-protein claims rather than vegan ethics.

skuLines.examples: Urban Platter Tofu, Hello Tempayy Tofu, Soyfit
skuLines.notes: Small but real demand from fitness-minded university students and younger staff. One facing; do not build depth.

skuLines.examples: Amul Ice Cream 1L, Vadilal 1L, Kwality Wall's 700ml, Verka 1L, Cream Bell 1L
skuLines.seasonality: Peaks Apr–Jun and Sept–Oct; collapses in hill winter Nov–Feb AND during residential breaks when the campus empties
skuLines.notes: Verka is the Punjab co-operative brand with natural pull for this community. Ice cream is the least forgiving line in the store: it needs a dedicated -18 to -22°C hard-freeze cabinet, and a single power cut that softens and refreezes a tub leaves visible ice crystals the customer rejects. Budget for genset/inverter backing before widening this range.

skuLines.examples: Amul 4L party pack, Vadilal 5L, Cream Bell 4L, Kwality Wall's bulk
skuLines.seasonality: Function-led — Gurpurab, Baisakhi, convocation, annual day, staff weddings, birthdays
skuLines.notes: With no alcohol anywhere on campus, ice cream is the celebration purchase, and 5,000 residents generate a steady calendar of functions. Also the input for a scooping counter.

skuLines.examples: Amul Cup, Vadilal Cup, Cream Bell Cup, Kwality Wall's Cup
skuLines.notes: The pocket-money price point for a 5–18 school cohort. Highest unit count of any frozen line; keep the cheap end (₹20–25) genuinely in stock, not just the ₹45 premium cup.

skuLines.examples: Kwality Wall's Cornetto, Amul Frostik / Tricone, Vadilal Cone, Cream Bell Cone
skuLines.notes: Top impulse SKU for the 12–25 age band. Cones go soggy if the cabinet cycles — a limp cone is the most common ice-cream complaint after crystallisation.

skuLines.line: Ice cream bars / sticks / choco bars
skuLines.examples: Amul Kool Choco Bar, Kwality Wall's Choco Bar, Vadilal Badam Bar, Feast
skuLines.notes: Multipacks convert a parent visit into six units; singles serve the child. Carry both.

skuLines.line: Ice candy / ice lolly — low price point
skuLines.examples: Vadilal Ice Candy, Amul Kool lollies, regional/local ice candy
skuLines.notes: The ₹10 sweet spot — the only frozen item a small child buys unaccompanied, and the highest-margin line in the cabinet. Non-dairy so it survives the chain better than real ice cream.

skuLines.examples: Vadilal Kulfi, Amul Kulfi, Kwality Wall's Matka Kulfi, Havmor
skuLines.notes: Traditional format with cross-generational appeal — the elderly cohort buys kulfi where they will not buy a Cornetto.

skuLines.examples: Kwality Wall's frozen dessert 1L, Cream Bell frozen dessert, regional value brands
skuLines.notes: Cheaper per litre and better margin than real ice cream, and it holds up better in a marginal cold chain. FSSAI requires it be labelled 'frozen dessert', not 'ice cream' — buyers increasingly check, so shelve it clearly and never sell it as ice cream.

skuLines.examples: Baskin-Robbins tub, Naturals, Hokey Pokey, Cream Bell Gourmet, Häagen-Dazs (very top end)
skuLines.notes: Real buyers exist here — senior faculty, visiting families, university students with money — and it is a want that otherwise leaks entirely to a town trip. Start with 2–3 SKUs; the cold-chain risk on a ₹600 tub is expensive to get wrong.

skuLines.line: Cassata / ice cream roll / ice cream cake / party bricks
skuLines.examples: Vadilal Cassata, Amul Tricone brick, Vadilal Ice Cream Cake, Havmor roll
skuLines.seasonality: Birthday and function driven, year-round with Mar–Oct peaks
skuLines.notes: Take pre-orders rather than holding stock — an ice cream cake that sits unsold for three weeks is a write-off, but a pre-order is pure margin. Natural attach to the party-pack line.

skuLines.line: Frozen yoghurt / frozen lassi / frozen shrikhand
skuLines.examples: Amul frozen dessert-adjacent, Mother Dairy frozen yoghurt, Epigamia frozen
skuLines.notes: Health-positioned dessert; small, urban-skewing demand. One or two facings at most.

skuLines.line: Frozen Indian sweets — gulab jamun, halwa, rasmalai
skuLines.examples: Haldiram's frozen Gulab Jamun, Bikano frozen sweets, Vadilal Quick Treats Halwa
skuLines.seasonality: Diwali, Gurpurab, Baisakhi, Lohri, convocation and wedding season
skuLines.notes: Buy in for the festival window and clear it — dead weight in the freezer the rest of the year. Gajar halwa specifically fits a HP winter.

skuLines.line: Frozen ready-to-cook veg gravies / curry bases / meal kits
skuLines.examples: ITC Master Chef gravies, iD Fresh curry pastes (chilled), Sumeru RTC Curry, Gits frozen-adjacent
skuLines.notes: Growth pocket in 2025–26 as dual-income households cook less, but on a campus with mess and langar access the base demand is thinner than in a metro. Test with 2–3 SKUs before widening.

skuLines.examples: ITC Master Chef Chicken Nuggets, Yummiez Chicken Seekh, Sumeru Prawns, Licious frozen
skuLines.notes: FLAG BEFORE BUYING: Kalgidhar Trust campuses are typically strictly vegetarian, so this whole block is very likely not stockable at Baru Sahib — confirm institutional policy in writing first. I have listed it rather than silently dropped it because the brief did not state a meat prohibition, only tobacco and alcohol. If it is prohibited, the veg nugget / soya chaap / paneer-snack lines carry this demand. Also needs physically separated storage and separate handling if ever permitted.

skuLines.line: Chilled mozzarella / pizza cheese / cheese slices and blocks
skuLines.examples: Amul Mozzarella 200g, Go Cheese Mozzarella, Britannia Slices, Milky Mist Mozzarella
skuLines.notes: Boundary line with the dairy lane, but it lives in this cabinet and without it the frozen pizza and cheese-snack lines do not convert. Shredded mozzarella freezes acceptably; slices do not — keep slices chilled.

skuLines.line: Frozen non-dairy whipping cream / whipped topping
skuLines.examples: Rich's Whip Topping, Tropolite Whipping Cream, Bakersville
skuLines.notes: Bought by the canteen/bakery, not households — it is what makes on-campus birthday cakes possible. Frozen shelf life ~9–12 months; must be thawed in the chiller, never at room temperature.

skuLines.line: Ice cubes, crushed ice and reusable gel ice packs
skuLines.examples: local/own-produced ice, Freezel gel packs, generic reusable ice packs
skuLines.seasonality: Ice peaks Apr–Jun and for functions; gel packs year-round
skuLines.notes: Two distinct jobs: party/beverage ice, and cold packs for the campus infirmary (sprains, fever) and for families carrying frozen goods home or down the hill. Own-produced ice is near-pure margin and needs no inbound cold chain at all — the one line in this lane immune to the road.

skuLines.line: Frozen grated coconut / curry leaf / herb cubes
skuLines.examples: Safal Grated Coconut, Sumeru Frozen Coconut, frozen ginger-garlic cubes
skuLines.notes: Small-basket add-on for South-Indian staff households; fresh coconut and curry leaf are hard to get 30–50km from a market.

trends2026: Quick-commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart) became the fastest-growing frozen channel in India and reshaped pack architecture — brands launched smaller 200–250g 'single-cook' packs alongside the traditional 400–500g pack, which is exactly the pack size a small hill store can turn without dead stock.

Frozen momos went mainstream beyond metros: ITC Master Chef, Wow! Momo and Godrej Yummiez pushed veg/paneer/corn-cheese momos into Tier-2 and Tier-3 general trade, so a Himachal store can now actually source them.
Air-fryer and OTG adoption in Indian kitchens turned on-pack air-fryer instructions into a purchase driver for fries, smiles and nuggets — packs without them lose the shelf comparison.

Plant-based and soya-based frozen (Vezlay, Blue Tribe, GoodDot, Hello Tempayy) repositioned from vegan-ethics to mainstream 'high-protein vegetarian' claims, which lands much better with a vegetarian institutional population than the older framing.

Consumer awareness of the FSSAI 'ice cream' vs 'frozen dessert' distinction sharpened, with real-ice-cream brands advertising 'made with milk, not vegetable fat' — shelve and describe the two tiers separately or lose trust.

Frozen Indian breads (malabar, laccha, stuffed paratha, naan) became the largest frozen-bread sub-segment, with iD Fresh's chilled short-life model competing directly against the frozen long-life model — the frozen model is the one that survives a hill road.

HyFun and other frozen-potato specialists expanded aggressively against McCain in both retail and HoReCa packs, which for the first time gives a small buyer real price negotiation on fries, smiles and tikkis.

Cold-chain and reefer aggregation extended into Tier-3 and hill towns, but power reliability and last-mile reefer remain the binding constraint — the assortment a hill store can carry is now set by its own freezer backup, not by supply.
adjacentServices: Brand-placed deep freezers and visi-coolers — Amul, Vadilal, Kwality Wall's and HyFun place cabinets free or on deposit against volume/exclusivity, which removes almost all the capex from widening this lane.

Institutional frozen supply contracts to the two ARY canteens, the school mess, the university mess and the hostel counters, on a weekly indent — the canteens are a bigger frozen buyer than all 5,000 residents' households combined.
Ice cream scooping counter or softy machine at a canteen — converts a ₹280 family tub into roughly ₹40 per scoop and is the single highest-margin move available in this category.

Function and party catering desk — 4L/5L party packs, cassata, ice cream cakes and catering-pack samosa/momo for Gurpurab, Baisakhi, annual day, convocation and staff weddings. With no alcohol on campus, ice cream and fried snacks ARE the celebration spend.
Standing monthly frozen indent for staff quarters — a fixed basket of peas, parathas, paneer and fries billed monthly, which smooths demand and makes reefer inbound predictable.
Insulated campus delivery — a cart with an insulated box so a family's frozen basket survives the walk home; frozen degrades within ~20 minutes in hill sun.
Short-term freezer locker / 'hold it frozen' pickup for families who buy a monthly load and cannot carry it in one trip.
Own ice production and gel-pack supply to the campus infirmary and to residents travelling down-hill — the only line in this category with no inbound cold-chain dependency.
Pre-order window for slow, high-value or perishable lines (premium tubs, ice cream cakes, puff pastry) so they are bought against a confirmed sale rather than held as freezer risk.
Air-fryer / OTG demonstration and co-selling with the clothing-and-general side of the store — an appliance sale locks in a recurring frozen-snack habit.

The WebSearch budget was fully exhausted (200/200 calls, consumed by the parallel fan-out) before this agent issued a single query, and every WebFetch attempt was refused. This list is therefore built from the model's own knowledge of Indian frozen/chilled retail (training data to ~May 2026), NOT from live 2026 pages. Treat brand names and product lines as reliable, and every PRICE BAND and MARGIN BAND as an unverified estimate that must be checked against a live distributor quote before it is used for buying decisions. Confidence: high on assortment structure and cohort logic, medium on 2026 pack sizes, LOW on prices and margins.
